versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated the Spraay contract address for Base in documentation.
- Added verified BatchDistributeHook contract address for Uniswap V4 (Base) to the documentation.

Initial release of DEX Batch Distribution skill, enabling efficient batch payouts via Spraay Protocol:

- Batch-distribute ETH or ERC-20 tokens to up to 200 recipients in a single transaction with DEX hook integrations.
- Supports Uniswap V4 (Base, BNB Chain), PancakeSwap Infinity (BNB Chain), SushiSwap (Base), Balancer v3 (Base), and a generic direct adapter.
- Integrates via @spraay/dex-adapters npm package with typescript examples for each supported DEX.
- Reduces gas costs by ~60% and charges a 30 bps protocol fee per batch.
- Eliminates recipient claim steps; sender controls all distribution off-chain in one transaction.
